subject.configuration_id: singnet/snet-daemon @ cbfd6736a14f14a5f86affce8e6e3b563e6f2bdc — heartbeat with no endpoint configured
capabilities: reporting whether the service behind the daemon can serve requests

checks.certifies: the service behind the daemon can serve requests

fault_injection.condition: the service accepts TCP connections and serves nothing — process alive, socket open, capability gone
fault_injection.how_produced: a local net.Listen that calls Accept and then does nothing with the connection; GetHeartbeat called with heartbeatType in {"", "none", "tcp"} and an empty heartbeat endpoint, which the daemon's own ValidateHeartbeatConfig treats as 'not configured, will be using service endpoint to ping the service'
fault_injection.targets: the declared capability, not the transport — the socket is deliberately left ACCEPTING so that only the ability to serve is removed

skipped: the grpc, http and https heartbeat paths were not exercised; this finding is scoped to the unconfigured fallback
unsupported: whether any deployed daemon runs unconfigured, and whether anything downstream acts on the Online status, were not determined

claim: Check set C was exercised against configuration X at time T. The check returned PASS under its declared fault injection, which is a MISSED FAULT and non-conforming. This is process evidence about the check.
_note: outcome PASS under the fault is a FAILURE of the check. A conforming attestation requires FAIL. This document is deliberately NON-CONFORMING and is published as the evidence of the defect.
